concurrency.what: two editors, one row: the stale write loses
concurrency.test: lets the first of two edits win and rejects the stale one

concurrency.what: a lifecycle decision made on a stale row is refused
concurrency.test: rejects a lifecycle decision made against a stale row

concurrency.what: a placement only lands on the revision the request read
concurrency.test: only lets the placement land on the row the request read

concurrency.what: archiving a category races article placement
concurrency.test: never leaves an archived category holding a placed article

concurrency.what: the same voter submits twice at once
concurrency.test: keeps one vote per user under two concurrent submissions of the same user

concurrency.what: eight votes land together and the totals stay exact
concurrency.test: keeps the totals exact when eight votes arrive together

concurrency.what: two curators resolve the same reader comment
concurrency.test: lets exactly one of two parallel resolves win and writes one audit row (W7.91)

concurrency.what: two writers draft the same reply
concurrency.test: lets two writers of the same reply produce exactly one draft

concurrency.what: two flushes race on the same day
concurrency.test: counts a day once when two flushes race on it

concurrency.what: two workers register the same schedule
concurrency.test: registers exactly one schedule when two workers start against the same Redis

failure.what: a crashed flush is retried and writes the day once
failure.test: writes a finished day once and treats a crash-retry as a no-op

failure.what: a Redis-less visit counts as a view, never as a new viewer
failure.test: counts a Redis-less visit as a view, never as a new viewer

failure.what: a failed draft takes its article with it, so the retry starts clean
failure.test: takes a failed draft with it, so the retry creates the one draft and no orphan

failure.what: the placement rolls back when the change log cannot be written
failure.test: takes the placement with it when the change log cannot be written

failure.what: the sweep comes back after Redis loses the registration
failure.test: restores the quarter-hourly sweep after Redis loses the registration

failure.what: one reminder per owner, and none on the second sweep
failure.test: sends one reminder per owner and none on the second sweep

failure.what: deleting a published article is refused and leaves everything in place
failure.test: refuses a published article with a 409 and leaves everything in place

failure.what: a resolve on an article the actor cannot write changes nothing
failure.test: refuses to resolve a comment on an article the actor cannot write (W7.91)

scope.what: owner-group membership is revoked on the next request
scope.test: scopes owner-group membership and revokes it on the next request

scope.what: clearing the reviewer assignment revokes review rights
scope.test: revokes review rights when the assignment is cleared

scope.what: restricted articles stay hidden from agents and foreign OU admins
scope.test: hides restricted articles from agents and foreign OU admins

scope.what: a forged foreign unit cannot be recorded
scope.test: refuses a foreign unit a plain user cannot open a ticket in

scope.what: a forged article id, draft or archived text is refused
scope.test: refuses an article of another service, a draft and an archived text

scope.what: an article the caller cannot read is refused
scope.test: refuses an article the caller cannot read, and an id that does not exist

corpus.what: a full walk has no gaps and no duplicates
corpus.test: walks the corpus page by page without gaps or duplicates

corpus.what: one request never reads past the scan budget
corpus.test: never reads more than the scan budget per request

corpus.what: a cursor that cannot be read is refused, not treated as the end
corpus.test: refuses a cursor it cannot read instead of pretending the page ended

corpus.what: the curator comment feed never skips a row when one is resolved
corpus.test: pages the curator comment feed and never skips a row when one is resolved (W7.90)

retention.what: archived articles lose title, body, comments, views, change log and inbox copies
retention.test: redacts archived articles, their comments, views, change log and inbox copies (W7.87)

retention.what: a deleted article's change-log trail is redacted, a live one is not
retention.test: redacts the change-log trail of a deleted article and leaves a live one alone (W7.88)
